messages:
Ellen Park: Heads-up — onboarding pain with the new vite-next-llamaindex template. Local dev works but after deploy some SSR/ISR routes intermittently surface 401s and occasionally an embedding endpoint returns what looks like an error payload (we cached it). Followed README, set REDWOOD_API_KEY. Repro below, any ideas? cc @Sam

Ellen Park: Repro handler used in the starter:
```js
// src/pages/api/embed.js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk-js'
const client = createClient(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY) // module scope
const cache = new Map()
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const k = req.body.text
  if (cache.has(k)) return res.json(cache.get(k))
  const out = await client.embed({ model: 'redwood/mini', input: k })
  cache.set(k, out)
  res.json(out)
}
```

Sam Gupta: Thanks. Are you seeing any headers on the 401 responses? If infra rotates keys you'll get x-rw-exp or x-rw-error. JS SDK should not swallow 401s into a 200 body. That sounds like two issues: (1) SDK surface shape for error responses, (2) starter caching raw body without checking status.

Ellen Park: Logs show: 
```
2026-05-13T10:21:43Z WARN upstream 401 x-rw-error=invalid_api_key x-rw-exp=42
2026-05-13T10:21:43Z ERROR handler uncaught -> 500
```

Riya Shah: Yep, this is a variant of the rotation parity gap. Python sdk added token-refresh and error semantics earlier this year; JS hasn't fully mirrored it. Short-term fixes: instantiate client per-request (avoid module scope) OR wrap calls and only cache on successful 2xx. Also avoid caching raw responses from network calls since 401 bodies can look like embeddings.

Connor Mills: I reproduced by simulating a short-lived key. Two additional things I noticed: (A) in monorepo/dev proxies the starter runs multiple apps in same process so a module-scoped client can be reused across apps — namespace collisions + stale auth. (B) SSE/stream endpoints behave worse — mid-stream 401s cause partial UI content. For the embed case we accidentally cached the error object as the embedding vector. Oof.

Sam Gupta: Proposed SDK change: on 401, inspect x-rw-exp if present; if expiry <= now + 20s then perform a one-off refresh and retry the request once. Also ensure all non-2xx responses throw an Error with metadata (status, headers, body) so callers can't accidentally treat an error payload as success.

Riya Shah: Agreed. Starter changes: update README to recommend a safe pattern and provide a small helper util. Example: 
```js
// utils/redwood-client.js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk-js'
export function getClient(req) { return createClient(req.headers['x-tenant-key'] || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY) }
```
And in handler create client per-request, and only cache when response.ok.

Ellen Park: Can we add a small preflight check before long-lived responses (streams) to avoid mid-stream auth failures? For streaming chat the UX is terrible when it cuts mid-way.

Connor Mills: Yes — implement a cheap ping/health call before opening SSE. Example: client.ping() that returns headers. If x-rw-exp <= now+15s then recreate client. We'll add that to the streaming examples in the starter.

Infra Bot: CI triggered: workflow/devex-vite-smoke.yml for branch fix/sdk-auth-retry (run 1/1) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam Gupta: I'll open the SDK PR implementing the single-retry-on-rotation behavior and change error shaping for non-2xx. Will include unit tests and a small e2e that simulates short-lived keys. Connor — can you add a Next smoke test that runs the starter and asserts no cached 401 bodies?

Connor Mills: On it. I'll also add an example of namespacing caches per-tenant (prefix keys) in the monorepo variant. We'll avoid in-memory shared caches for multi-tenant staged deployments in the README.

Riya Shah: QA: add an e2e that reproduces the embedding-cache leak: simulate 401 then ensure cache doesn't store the 401 payload. Also add a streaming preflight test that simulates mid-stream rotation. Assigning QA ticket DX-847.

Sam Gupta: Draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/945 — implements refresh-on-rotation + error normalization. Includes unit tests and a minimal e2e harness that flips a short-lived key.

Ellen Park: Thanks — I'll update the starter README and examples to include the ping preflight, per-request client factory, and a note about not caching raw network bodies. Pushed example docs to examples/auth-rotation.md in the starter repo.

Connor Mills: CI green on the helper + smoke tests, merged branch. Verified staging: SSR/ISR and embed endpoints stable, no cached 401s. Streaming preflight reduced mid-stream aborts in simulated tests.

QA Lead: Closing DX-847 after verifying telemetry in staging shows no residual 401 spikes for the starter. Follow-up: track SDK parity completion for streaming retry semantics.

Ellen Park: Great work — onboarding flows are smooth again. Saving repro and notes in the starter repo. :tada:
